## Problem

## Requirements

Create the logic for producing terms in the look-and-say sequence. The prompt illustrates the sequence with:

```text
11, 21, 1211,...
```

A suitable interface may be either of the following:

```python
def next_term(s: str) -> str:...
def nth_term(n: int) -> str:...
```

First establish whether the requested operation is to compute one term after a supplied string or to produce the nth term beginning from a predetermined seed.

## Hints

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

The look-and-say sequence is generated by reading the digits of the previous term and counting consecutive identical digits—e.g., '11' becomes '21' (two 1s).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

For next_term(s), iterate through s, count runs of the same digit, and build the result as count followed by the digit.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 3</summary>

For nth_term(n), start from a seed (usually '1') and apply next_term repeatedly n-1 times.

</details>
